entities.name: customer
entities.description: A person with an account, whether or not they have ordered.

measures.name: Customer lifetime value
measures.definition: Total value of every payment a customer has made, across all orders and payment methods, in Australian dollars.

rules.name: one-formula-per-measure
rules.description: Every column bound to a measure computes it the same way.

rules.name: entity-keys-are-unique
rules.description: The key of an entity named in definitions.yml has a uniqueness test, a primary key or is an identifier field.

rules.name: entity-names-are-distinct
rules.description: A term of kind entity does not give its name to an entity whose keys it does not bind.

rules.name: bound-columns-exist
rules.description: Every column a business term names exists in the data stack.
violations: definitions.yml:20: term 'Order amount': bound column 'orders.amount' is ambiguous (model.jaffle_shop.orders#amount, table.jaffle_shop.archive.orders#amount); qualify it

rules.name: approved-terms-are-owned
rules.description: An approved term has an owner and an approval date.
